name: Find The Flags (350) 🌍
desc:
Welcome to the Find The Flags

In this game, you aim to find the flags found in the worlds!

Count of flags = 350

💡 How to play:
- Look for flags
- When you find a flags, touch it
- Collect 350 flags around the game 🎌

👍 Click like if you like the game

- This game contains flags of Countries, Territories, Capitals and other.
- The game does not support politics related stuff.
